sources.entry: LuLu - LuLu is the free macOS firewall that aims to block unauthorized (outgoing) network traffic. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/objective-see/LuLu) [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](1) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: LuLu
summary.one_liner: LuLu is a free, open-source macOS firewall that alerts on and blocks unauthorized outgoing network connections.
use_cases: Blocking unknown outgoing connections from apps on a Mac
Detecting malware calling home on macOS
Creating per-app or per-endpoint network allow/block rules
Monitoring which processes are connecting to the network
Adding host or IP allow and block lists on macOS
summary.what_it_does: LuLu is a free, open-source firewall for macOS that focuses on outgoing traffic. When a new unauthorized outbound connection is made, it shows an alert with the process name and destination, letting the user block or allow it. Decisions create rules that apply to the whole program or just a specific remote endpoint, with optional expiry times. The Rules window groups rules by default, Apple, third-party, user and recent, and supports manual rule entry, import and export. Settings cover automatic allowing of Apple and installed programs, DNS traffic, passive and block modes, allow and block lists, and profiles (v4.0+). It also bundles the Netiquette network monitor and offers VirusTotal lookups from alerts.
notable: Free and open source; alerts when a new outgoing connection is attempted
Per-process or per-remote-endpoint rules with optional expiry
Allow and block lists of hosts/IPs that override rules; profiles in v4.0+
Bundles Netiquette network monitor and VirusTotal hash lookup from alerts
caveats: Requires manual approval of a System Extension and Network Filter in macOS System Settings during installation
Only monitors outgoing traffic; some traffic not routed through Network Extensions cannot be seen or blocked
Hostname blocking only works for Network.framework or NSURLSession connections; Chrome-style apps only support IP blocking
Clicking VirusTotal sends a file hash to VirusTotal
